tool_args.rationale: The new observations show a sharp gradient-dependent decline beyond the pilot range, consistent with the diagnosed critical-threshold avalanche. Fit the three base parameters and two avalanche parameters jointly, then test fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It fit the pilot but was decisively refuted on fresh confirmation and cannot explain the high-gradient collapse.
The high-gradient measurements directly constrain the suspected threshold; there is no evidence that a temporal ODE is needed.
Already acquired; its three observations constrain the avalanche branch.
It does not distinguish the relevant mechanisms.
